defect_description: Under 1,000 active students, FastAPI worker scaling ($N \ge 5$) combined with default pool configurations ($20 	ext{ pool} + 20 	ext{ overflow}$ per worker) will exceed PostgreSQL's `max_connections` limit (200), resulting in immediate client-side `500/504` errors.

Dynamic tables suffer from massive bloat—notably `student_question_flags` (90.91% dead tuples), `users` (41.86%), `bkt_states` (40.91%), and `student_answers` (50%). This bloat, combined with duplicate indexes, increases page fragmentation and write amplification.

The use of `TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM` for question retrieval samples database disk blocks rather than random rows. Since PostgreSQL heap files store rows in insertion order, students receive clustered, highly correlated question blocks, skewing IRT theta ($	heta$) estimates.

The current Redis Sentinel caching architecture caches negative lookups (`{"__sentinel_null__": True}`) for 60 seconds. A lack of API rate-limiting or strict input validation allows attackers to flood the system with arbitrary key inputs, causing cache penetration and risk of Redis Out-Of-Memory (OOM) crashes.

Inactive questions (`is_active = False`) in `question_bank` have active reference records in child tables: 381 rows in `irt_calibration_history` and 15 rows in `student_question_flags`. This creates analytical skew in calibration pipelines and causes client-side rendering crashes.

defect_description: Showstopper: FastAPI Pool & DB Connection Mismatch
remediation_action: Lower connection pool sizing variables (`db_pool_size = 15`, `db_pool_max_overflow = 15`) and scale PostgreSQL kernel limits to `max_connections = 250` immediately to prevent connection starvation.

defect_description: Showstopper: Missing Indexes on `question_bank`
remediation_action: Deploy `idx_qb_review_status_active` and `idx_qb_beta_filter_rule` concurrently to stop 1.5s sequential scans.

defect_description: Showstopper: TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM Replacement
remediation_action: Remove block-based sampling from Repository layers. Utilize randomized ID index lookups to guarantee fair pedagogical randomness.

defect_description: Showstopper: Logical Orphan Cleanup
remediation_action: Run cleanup scripts to cascade updates/purges for active reference records pointing to deactivated parent questions in `irt_calibration_history` and `student_question_flags`.

defect_description: Showstopper: Sentinel Cache Protection Enforcement
remediation_action: Implement strict UUID validation on target endpoints and configure rate limit filters on cache routers to prevent Redis memory exhaustion.

defect_description: Showstopper: Pydantic Input Validation Gaps
remediation_action: Implement trimmed validation constraints (`strip()`) and control-character filters on API router inputs to sanitize options and rationales prior to write actions.

defect_description: Showstopper: Production Workspace Cleanup
remediation_action: Drop the large legacy backup tables (`question_bank_irt_bootstrap_backup_20260530`, `question_bank_cleanup_rejected_backup_20260603`) to free catalog memory and storage buffers.
